title: Monte Carlo density and estimator accuracy
description: Compares finite-sample density approximations and independently measured mean-estimation RMSE with the analytic σ/√N law.

reproduction.method: Gaussian sampling, normalized histograms, Gaussian KDE and repeated-trial RMSE
reproduction.description: Compares finite-sample density approximations and independently measured mean-estimation RMSE with the analytic σ/√N law.
differences: Independent TypeScript conceptual reproduction; not execution or validation of the original MATLAB/Octave program.
Uses the original active Gaussian N(1.5,0.25²), not the inactive Gamma branch; sample sizes 10,100,1000.
Explicit Gaussian KDE with Silverman bandwidth replaces ksdensity; fixed histogram coordinates correct the original unlocated bar call.
Adds 100 actual independent Monte Carlo trials for accuracy diagnostics.

checks.name: Full sample mean is within six theoretical standard errors
